Name: Strawberry Cow Recipes
Author: larkylovesyou2
Description:
[size=3]Prefer [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23644]Angora's Strawberry Cows[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38891]Abrah's Strawberry Milk Cows[/url], but still want some cute strawberry cooking recipes? Not a problem! With this fork of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44308]my Strawberry Cows mod[/url], I've adapted the recipes to use Strawberry Milk products from other mods instead![/size]

[size=4][b]:: Features ::[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Adds 7 new recipes: Strawberry Matcha, Strawberry Latte, Strawberry Milk Bun, Strawberry Muffin, Strawberry Milkshake, Strawberry Cheesecake, and Fruit Sandwich. All of these recipes can be crafted using either Strawberry Milk or Strawberry Cheese/Butter.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Strawberry Cows aren't your only source of milk! You can cook Strawberry Milk using one strawberry and one of any type of milk.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Angora's Strawberry Cheese can now be aged in casks![/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]:: Compatibility ::[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]This mod, Angora's Strawberry Cows, [i]and[/i] my Strawberry Cows are all compatible with one another; you can have cows from both mods and be able to make all recipes with either's milk/cheese. All of the recipes independently route to the same item ID, regardless of which one you have installed; you should only need to cook one version of the recipe to count it toward perfection.[/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]:: Recipes ::[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][b]Strawberry Milk: [/b]1 Milk (Any) & 1 Strawberry[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][b]Strawberry Matcha:[/b] 1 Strawberry Milk & 1 Green Tea[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][b]Strawberry Latte:[/b] 1 Strawberry Milk & 1 Coffee[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][b]Strawberry Milk Bun:[/b] 1 Strawberry Milk, 1 Sugar, 1 Wheat Flour, & 1 Egg (Any)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][b]Strawberry Milkshake:[/b] 1 Strawberry Milk & 1 Sugar[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][b]Strawberry Cheesecake:[/b] 1 Strawberry Cheese, 1 Egg (Any), 2 Strawberries, & 1 Sugar[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8][b]Fruit Sandwich:[/b] 1 Bread, 1 Jelly, 1 Strawberry Cheese/Butter, & 1 Banana[/color][/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Strawberry Milk Recipes
Manifest.Description: Adapts the recipes from Larky's Strawberry Cows for compatibility with Angora's and Abrah's mods. Does nothing if you don't have either of them installed.
Manifest.Author: larkylovesyou2
